title: Competitive Parity and Technical Product Hardening
description: Raise Boreal's business logic and operational sophistication to peer level with independently verifiable closeout, multi-machine collaboration, review and merge workflows, spec interoperability, agent adapters, extensions, and progressive UX while preserving its source-to-decision-to-work-to-proof differentiation. Public licensing changes and real-user beta validation are explicitly deferred.
acceptanceCriteria: Every in-scope child sprint is closed with descendant evidence, passing verification, and Git checkpoint coverage.
Two independent clones can collaborate, resolve conflicts, recover interrupted synchronization, and preserve every durable record.
Closeout distinguishes agent-reported, Boreal-witnessed, human-attested, and external-CI evidence and can require current witnessed proof.
Independent review, acceptance, resumable merge, and spec or change interoperability are available as first-class workflows.
First-class adapters cover the supported agent runtimes with deterministic installation, update, and compatibility diagnostics.
A versioned extension contract supports validation, capability declaration, failure isolation, and reproducible installation.
Simple, Team, and Governed profiles expose coherent CLI, console, CI, and optional TUI workflows without weakening underlying invariants.
Cross-platform packaging, install, upgrade, migration, rollback, and benchmark suites pass through automated technical validation.
The existing license remains unchanged and external user validation is not required for this milestone.
